hydrogen.label: Hydrogen production projects
hydrogen.coverage: African rows with numeric project references from the IEA-derived workbook; coordinates are retained only where published.
limitations: This pinned research mirror predates the June 2026 official IEA release.
Source normalised hydrogen-output capacities can be estimates; they are not measured production.
Project status is historical; targets and announcements are not operating output.

carbonCapture.label: Carbon capture and storage projects
carbonCapture.source: IEA CCUS 2026 via CCUS Policy Hub mirror
carbonCapture.coverage: African project records from the pinned IEA-derived mirror. Capture, use, storage and full-chain entries are kept distinct.
limitations: Mirror records are not independently verified current project status.
Country and state anchors in the mirror are excluded from facility markers.
Project capacities can overlap within a hub and must not be summed as unique captured or avoided emissions.

geothermal.label: Geothermal power units
geothermal.source: Global Energy Monitor (TU Berlin / PyPSA download mirror)
geothermal.coverage: African generating-unit records from the March 2026 Global Geothermal Power Tracker. Several units may share one plant and coordinates.
limitations: Unit counts are not plant-site counts.
Capacity is nameplate MW, not electricity generation.
Approximate locations and source project statuses are retained and identified.

emissions.label: Power-sector emissions estimates
emissions.coverage: African point-source power-sector records, year 2025, gas co2e_100yr. Totals apply only to retained inventory records.
limitations: Estimated greenhouse-gas emissions, not direct measurements.
Units are metric tonnes CO2e, AR6 GWP100, per year.
Restricted activity and capacity fields are omitted; inventory sums are not national totals.
